room.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background art for Sound Detective, a Windows point-and-click audio restoration game. Generate ONE wide 16:9 landscape room interior, ideally 1920x1080 or 2048x1152. Scene: a private vintage music restoration studio inside an old city building at blue hour, with convincing depth and perspective like a carefully lit realistic adventure-game environment. Camera at standing eye height from the entrance, three-quarter wide view. A substantial walnut recording/mixing console occupies the LOWER CENTER and foreground, with visible faders, small recorder and cables; one leather rolling studio chair tucked in, not blocking the console. Warm brass desk lamps, two nearfield monitoring speakers behind the console, acoustic wood slats and fabric absorber panels, a small rear window showing the blue evening city. On the UPPER LEFT wall place a large clearly visible rectangular cork project board with pinned blank song cue cards, waveform-like sketches and sheet music; its full border must be visible so it can be a clickable case board. To the RIGHT of the console a separate vintage analog effects rack with two stacked distinct metal units, knobs and amber lamps. On the left a small sofa with headphones and a few vinyl sleeves, books, score sheets and tape boxes. A reel-to-reel evidence player sits on the console's left, a small green analysis monitor on its right. The room should feel inviting, practical and musically focused with restrained detective character, not a police evidence office. Deep walnut, muted petrol/teal, charcoal acoustic treatment, warm amber light. Clear separation of the console and case board silhouettes for interactive highlights. Comfortable but organized realistic clutter. Premium detailed 3D render / cinematic environmental illustration with grounded proportions and readable objects. No humans, no floating UI, no overlay labels, no legible letters or logos, no watermark, no neon, no spaceship panels, no fantasy ornaments, no flat floorplan. Keep the upper 10 percent quiet enough for a game header and bottom 8 percent unobstructed by important objects.

console.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / camera reframe. Asset type: second production background for the same Sound Detective music restoration studio. Input image is a REFERENCE for the exact room, lighting, materials and equipment family. Create a NEW closely framed eye-level view from the operator position in front of the same walnut mixing desk. Wide 16:9 landscape, ideally 1920x1080 or 2048x1152. The main desk and all five interactive equipment objects occupy most of the view: LEFT a large analog reel-to-reel recorder with two visible reels and VU meters; CENTER a sloping walnut/charcoal mixing console with large clearly visible vertical faders, rows of knobs and warm meters, to act as the frequency-recovery and pitch-calibration workstation; CENTER-RIGHT a distinct green CRT analysis monitor with a simple waveform/spectrum display; FAR RIGHT two separate stacked metal rack devices, upper delay canceller and lower reverb-restoration device, clearly separated, each with several large rotary knobs, a small VU meter and small amber/red status lamps. Keep all five objects fully in frame with clear contours, no crop on the right-hand units. Leave the main interactive objects below the top 12 percent game-header area and above the bottom 12 percent caption area. A pair of monitor loudspeakers, the blue-hour window, wood-slat acoustic treatment and a hint of the left wall's cue board remain in the background to establish this is the same room. Walnut desktop edge in foreground, headphones, pencil, one small notebook and tape box as modest clutter away from equipment controls. Warm desk lamp from upper left, restrained amber practicals and cool dusk through the rear window. Cinematic realistic 3D adventure-game environment, rich physical depth, tactile metal and wood, muted petrol/teal and charcoal. This is an environmental background, not a flat software panel. No people, no legible words, no brand logos, no UI overlays, no white labels, no neon, no watermark. Preserve the inviting music-studio style of the reference; do not return to a police office. The knobs and faders are illustrative art and will be overlaid with real game interaction.

notes: Generated environmental art. Localized text, interactive outlines and working controls are drawn by Qt; painted meters and screens are illustrative.
